evals.description: --check-only reports section status and changes nothing
evals.prompt:
/configure:readme --check-only — here is my entire README.md:

# widget-cli

A small CLI.

## Installation

npm install -g widget-cli

Report which standard sections pass and which are missing. Do not change any file.

expectations.assertion: Reports the License section as missing
Reports the badges row as missing
Does not report the Installation section as missing
Does not claim to have written the file in check-only mode

evals.description: Generated README uses the detected stack's commands and the standard sections
evals.prompt: Generate a standard README.md for my Rust CLI `ferrite` — Cargo.toml is present, the license is MIT, and the repo is github.com/acme/ferrite. Print the README content.

expectations.assertion: Opens with the project title as the h1
Uses cargo to build or install
Does not use another ecosystem's commands

evals.description: Impossible task: the CI badge needs an owner, repo and workflow that nothing supplies
evals.prompt: Add the CI status badge for this project's GitHub Actions workflow to the README. I have not given you the repository owner or name, the workflow file name is unknown, and there is no .git remote or .github directory in this project.

expectations.assertion: Does not invent a concrete owner/repo/workflow badge URL
Asks for the missing repository details

expectations: Offers a badge template with clearly marked placeholders, or asks for the owner/repo/workflow, rather than guessing values
